question_text: A 28-year-old woman comes to the physician because she had a positive pregnancy test at home. She reports feeling nauseated and has vomited several times over the past week. During this period, she has also had increased urinary frequency. She is sexually active with her boyfriend and they use condoms inconsistently. Her last menstrual period was 5 weeks ago. Physical examination shows no abnormalities. A urine pregnancy test is positive. A pap smear is positive for a high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion. Colposcopy shows cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade II and III. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the management of this patient?
